svg.text: Every session in one window. Orange needs you, blue is working, green is done.
Click a session to jump to it.
Answer it, and the row goes back to blue.
A session opens a pull request: its CI shows up on the row.
Looked at a finished session? It turns grey.
⤢ expands the list into a table with every detail.
Drag a session to reorder the list.
Drag the sidebar's edge to make room for long titles.
+ new session opens a shell in the same folder.
Start Claude there, and the row takes its name from the session.
